# Desk: test plan

Version 1.1.0-dev of the specification: 3 design tests, 2 golden and 1 red, about 2 subjects. Golden tests show a path that succeeds, red tests a path that is refused. The test cases follow the test case specification of ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119-3.

## 1. Levels and how the tests run

| Level | Design tests |
|---|---|
| system | 3 |

System and acceptance tests are design tests, written in the specification and run by every implementation. Unit and integration tests belong to one implementation and are listed with it below.

## 2. Test cases

### Command lend

#### lend-succeeds

Scenario: golden; level: system; verifies DESK-1.

- Given: a copy on the shelf
- When: lend is run
- Then: it exits 0

#### lend-usage-error

Scenario: red; level: system; covers usage error; verifies DESK-1.

- Given: a copy on the shelf
- When: lend is run with an argument it does not accept
- Then: it prints how to use it and exits with the usage status

### Command renew

#### renew-succeeds

Scenario: golden; level: system; verifies DESK-2.

- Given: a loan not yet due
- When: renew is run
- Then: it exits 0

## 3. Requirements by release

2 requirements name the release they are meant for. Each release lists its requirements and the design tests that verify them, so a release is tested with its own scope.

### Release 1.0.0

| Requirement | Priority | Verified by |
|---|---|---|
| DESK-1 | must | lend-succeeds, lend-usage-error |

### Release 1.1.0

| Requirement | Priority | Verified by |
|---|---|---|
| DESK-2 | should | renew-succeeds |

### No release named

| Requirement | Priority | Verified by |
|---|---|---|
| DESK-3 | could | none |

## 4. Derived cases left out

3 cases the design implies have no test and are not written by default: none is about a subject that satisfies a requirement with a harm, none is a case nobody exercises by hand (a failing dependency, two writers on one record), and none is a mistake users make often. Writing a test that covers one removes it from this list.

| Subject | Case | Scenario | Why it is left out |
|---|---|---|---|
| requirement DESK-1 | acceptance 1 | golden | DESK-1 names no harm |
| requirement DESK-2 | acceptance 1 | golden | DESK-2 names no harm |
| requirement DESK-3 | acceptance 1 | golden | DESK-3 names no harm |
